# FG-AUTH-0007

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_taken_employee_number_or_external_id_is_user_identifier_taken` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この社員番号または外部 ID は、すでに別のユーザーに使われています。
- en: This employee number or external ID is already used by another user.
- id: Nomor karyawan atau ID eksternal ini sudah digunakan oleh pengguna lain.

## 原因 (cause)

Another user already has the same employee_number, or the same external_id for the same auth_source (unique indexes users_employee_number and users_external_id on forge.users).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason` (employee_number_taken or external_id_taken); the value is not logged (personal data). Find the other account with a privileged query on forge.users (the read pool cannot see these columns); a duplicate usually means a re-hired employee or an LDAP entry that was recreated.

## 対処 (fix)

An administrator decides which account keeps the identifier: disable or correct the stale account, then retry.
